en.title: araS
en.summary: Personal asset, portfolio and retirement tracker — designed, built and shipped to the App Store solo.
en.problem: Assets, liabilities, holdings and insurance policies sit scattered across banks, brokers and spreadsheets, so net worth is never visible at a glance — and no existing tool covers TW/US holdings, dividends and retirement projection in one place.
en.outcome: Built end to end alone: a Turborepo monorepo where a Next.js 15 web/API and an Expo iOS app share one API surface, one set of Zod schemas and one Clerk auth flow. Version 1.3 is on the App Store, with a RevenueCat premium subscription, Sentry crash monitoring and JS updates pushed over the air through EAS.

zh.title: araS
zh.summary: 個人資產、投資組合與退休試算 App，從設計、開發到上架 App Store 全程獨立完成。
zh.problem: 資產、負債、持股與保單分散在各家銀行、券商與試算表，淨資產永遠看不到全貌；市面上也沒有同時涵蓋台股美股持股、股息與退休金試算的工具。
zh.outcome: 一人從頭做到底：以 Turborepo 讓 Next.js 15 網頁／API 與 Expo iOS App 共用同一套 API、Zod schema 與 Clerk 認證。目前 App Store 版本 1.3，並以 RevenueCat 提供 Premium 訂閱、Sentry 監控當機、EAS OTA 直接推送即時更新。

en.title: reteP
en.summary: Daily food and calorie logging, ported from the web app into a native iOS app.
en.problem: The web version already worked, but opening a browser for every meal is friction nobody repeats three times a day — food logging only sticks when it is one tap away on the phone.
en.outcome: Ported the web UI one-to-one into an Expo app that reuses the existing FastAPI backend and Clerk auth, then shipped it to the App Store on 19 Aug 2026: Sign in with Apple, macro rings, calendar history, yearly SVG trend charts and a personal food library — with day-to-day updates delivered over the air.

zh.title: reteP
zh.summary: 每日飲食與熱量記錄，從網頁版移植為原生 iOS App。
zh.problem: 網頁版已經能用，但每一餐都要打開瀏覽器記錄，摩擦大到沒人願意一天做三次；飲食追蹤只有在手機上一鍵可達時才留得住使用者。
zh.outcome: 將網頁版 UI 1:1 移植成 Expo App，共用既有的 FastAPI 後端與 Clerk 認證，2026/08/19 上架 App Store：支援 Sign in with Apple、營養素環圈、日曆歷史紀錄、以 SVG 純 JS 繪製的年度趨勢圖與個人食物庫，日常更新以 OTA 直接推送。

en.title: U-Turn
en.summary: Automated badminton grouping and match scheduling system.
en.problem: Organizing badminton meetups requires manually grouping players by skill level and balancing teams, which is time-consuming and error-prone.
en.outcome: Built an automated grouping system that generates balanced matchups in seconds, streamlining registration and scheduling for badminton groups.

zh.title: U-Turn
zh.summary: 自動化羽球分組與賽程安排系統
zh.problem: 羽球團體活動需手動依程度與人數平衡分組，耗時且容易出錯。
zh.outcome: 建立自動化分組系統，依程度快速產生平衡賽程，簡化報名與分組流程，提升活動運作效率。

en.title: Market Trend Tracking Platform
en.summary: Monitoring growth data from GitHub, Hugging Face, etc., to provide policy suggestions.
en.problem: Integrating heterogeneous data sources with frequent updates posed a significant challenge to system performance.
en.outcome: Built a relational database mapping tech to vendors, matching international trends with domestic supply chains for strategic advising.

zh.title: 國內市場趨勢追蹤平台
zh.summary: 依據網路爬蟲領域關鍵字、監測Github Hugging Face等相關成長數據，對應國內公司資訊，依照微光、新興、主流趨勢，提供相對應政策
zh.problem: 需整合異質數據源（網路爬蟲、API、內部資料庫），且數據更新頻繁，對系統效能造成巨大挑戰。
zh.outcome: 建立「技術-廠商」關聯資料庫，智慧媒合國際趨勢與國內供應鏈，為政府與投資人提供具體的策略建議地圖。

en.title: Digital Chatroom
en.summary: Configurable chatroom switching via environment variables.
en.problem: Facing diverse chat needs across business units, lacking a universal swappable solution.
en.outcome: Developed a flexible chat platform using env vars to control endpoints and styles, supporting multiple internal tools.

zh.title: 數位聊天室
zh.summary: 依環境變數切換不同數位工具的聊天室
zh.problem: 面對不同業務端的聊天需求，缺乏一套能夠快速抽換設定的通用解決方案。
zh.outcome: 開發具備高度彈性的聊天平台，利用環境變數控制 API 端點與 UI 風格，成功支援多組內部工具的即時通訊需求。

en.title: Taiwan Info Service Provider Database
en.summary: Connecting to MOEA database for searching and filtering providers.
en.problem: Difficulty in finding info service providers due to lack of transparency and intuitive filtering mechanisms.
en.outcome: Connected to MOEA API, built a high-performance responsive platform with React and Jotai, optimizing info retrieval.

zh.title: 台灣資訊服務業者資料庫
zh.summary: 串接經濟部資料庫，提供台灣資訊服務業者的查詢與篩選功能
zh.problem: 企業尋找資訊服務商如同大海撈針，缺乏透明的資訊與比較基準；缺乏直覺的篩選與搜尋機制，使用者必須手動比對資料，耗時且效率低落。
zh.outcome: 成功串接經濟部 API，運用 React 與 Jotai 打造高效能的響應式查詢平台，實現即時多條件篩選，大幅優化資訊檢索體驗。

en.title: AI Agent Collaboration Platform
en.problem: Enterprises need quick, custom AI bot construction, but existing solutions lack flexibility.
en.outcome: Created a GPT-like interface with knowledge base support, multi-turn dialogue, and task automation.

zh.title: AI Agent 協作平台
zh.problem: 企業需要快速建構客製化 AI 聊天機器人，但現有方案缺乏彈性且整合困難。需要一個能連接多種 AI 模型、支援即時互動的平台。
zh.outcome: 成功打造 GPT-like 對話介面與知識庫系統，支援多輪對話、檔案上傳、任務自動化功能，大幅降低企業導入 AI 的門檻。

en.title: Campus Gender Equality Program
en.summary: Government-funded campus programme on gender equality and personal safety.
en.problem: Traditional education lacks systematic gender and safety advocacy.
en.outcome: Managed gov bids, coordinated 30+ seminars in 6 months, reaching 1,000+ students and staff.

zh.title: 校園性別平權宣講計畫
zh.summary: 政府標案：校園多元性別與自我保護宣講計畫。
zh.problem: 既有教育體系缺乏多元性別與自我保護的系統性宣導。
zh.outcome: 承接並執行政府標案，半年內統籌 30+ 場講座，精準觸及超過 1,000 名學生與教職人員。

en.title: Dept. Store CSR Alliance
en.summary: A cross-sector CSR partnership with Far Eastern Department Store.
en.problem: Low awareness and fundraising difficulty for vulnerable groups like teen pregnancy.
en.outcome: Partnered with Far Eastern Dept. Store, leveraging CSR resources to raise 100k+ in a single event.

zh.title: 百貨 CSR 異業結盟
zh.summary: 與遠東百貨跨界合作的企業 CSR 公益活動。
zh.problem: 家暴與未成年懷孕等弱勢議題關注度低，推廣與募款困難。
zh.outcome: 促成與遠東百貨跨界合作，結合企業 CSR 資源提升品牌能見度，單檔活動募得逾 10 萬元善款。

en.title: Digital Fundraising Project
en.summary: Moving a foundation's fundraising online to reach donors beyond one city.
en.problem: Offline fundraising limited by geography, making it hard to scale.
en.outcome: Implemented digital strategies, optimized donation paths, successfully raised 700k.

zh.title: 數位轉型募款專案
zh.summary: 把基金會募款搬到線上，突破地域限制。
zh.problem: 傳統線下募款受限於地域性，難以擴大受眾規模。
zh.outcome: 導入數位行銷策略突破地域限制，優化線上捐款路徑，成功募資達 70 萬元。

en.title: Omni-channel Production
en.summary: Ad and video production that gave the sales team credible brand assets.
en.problem: Lack of credible brand assets led to high trust costs for lead generation.
en.outcome: Coordinated ad and video production, building brand trust and driving 3M+ in sales growth.

zh.title: 全媒體內容行銷製作
zh.summary: 統籌廣告與影音製作，為業務團隊建立品牌素材。
zh.problem: 業務推廣缺乏具公信力的品牌素材，導致客戶信任成本高。
zh.outcome: 統籌廣告與影音內容產製，建立品牌信賴資產，協助業務團隊創造約 300 萬業績成長。
